The '''1967–68 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 32nd season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 8 October 1967 and ended on 10 June 1968. [[AEK Athens F.C.|AEK Athens]] won their fourth Greek title and their first one in five years. The season was the first of several seasons in which the [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] champion would play in the Alpha Ethniki the following season.  [[Olympiakos Nicosia]] finished second to last and were relegated back to the [[Cypriot First Division]].

The point system was: ''Win: 3 points'' - ''Draw: 2 points'' - ''Loss: 1 point''.
